yt_title: How Much Honey Does One Bee Make In Its Life? #Shorts
desc: One honey bee makes only about one twelfth of a teaspoon of honey in her whole life. A worker bee lives about six weeks in summer. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: One teaspoon takes twelve bees! 🐝 Would you share your honey now? Follow for a fact every day. Send this to a honey lover. Comment YES or NO.

lines.text: How much honey does one bee make in a lifetime?
Only about one twelfth of a teaspoon, her whole life.
A worker bee only lives about six weeks in summer.
Her wings beat around two hundred times every second.
So one teaspoon of honey is the lifetime work of twelve bees.
